# NumPy

> NumPy is the fundamental package for array computing and scientific computing in Python, providing tools for numerical operations, data analysis, and scientific research.

NumPy serves as the foundation for the scientific Python ecosystem, enabling researchers and data scientists across academia and industry to perform efficient numerical computations. The project is maintained by a global community with institutional support and emphasizes accessibility through comprehensive documentation, tutorials, and educational resources.

## Key Topics

- array computing
- numerical computing
- scientific computing
- Python library
- open source
- data analysis
- API reference
- installation
- community contribution

- SciPy
- Pandas

- case studies
- getting started

## Getting Started

- [NumPy Homepage](https://numpy.org): NumPy homepage showcasing array computing and scientific tools
- [Installing NumPy](https://numpy.org/install): Installation guide for NumPy with pip, conda, uv, and pixi
- [Learn NumPy](https://numpy.org/learn): Learning resources including tutorials, Jupyter notebooks, and guides
- [Get Help](https://numpy.org/gethelp): Support resources including StackOverflow and community forums

## Documentation & Reference

- [NumPy v2.4 Manual](https://numpy.org/doc/stable): Complete NumPy v2.4 API reference and user guide documentation
- [NumPy Enhancement Proposals (NEPs)](https://numpy.org/neps/roadmap.html): NumPy development roadmap including interoperability and performance goals
- [Citing NumPy](https://numpy.org/citing-numpy): Citation formats and bibliographic information for NumPy research

## Real-World Applications

- [First Image of a Black Hole](https://numpy.org/case-studies/blackhole-image): Case study on NumPy use in Event Horizon Telescope black hole imaging
- [Discovery of Gravitational Waves](https://numpy.org/case-studies/gw-discov): Case study on NumPy use in LIGO gravitational wave detection
- [DeepLabCut 3D Pose Estimation](https://numpy.org/case-studies/deeplabcut-dnn): Case study on NumPy use in DeepLabCut pose estimation and tracking
- [Cricket Analytics](https://numpy.org/case-studies/cricket-analytics): Case study on NumPy application in Indian Premier League analytics

## Community & Contribution

- [About NumPy](https://numpy.org/about): Project history, governance, steering council, and institutional partners
- [Community Overview](https://numpy.org/community): Community overview with communication channels and contribution guidelines
- [Contribute to NumPy](https://numpy.org/contribute): Contribution guide for code, documentation, and issue triaging
- [News & Announcements](https://numpy.org/news): Release notes, announcements, and fellowship program updates
